items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Ben was a disciple of Coleman Hawkins, as most every tenor player was and Ben loved Coleman

ctx.x: Oh, Ben? Ben was a disciple of Coleman Hawkins, as most every tenor player was and Ben loved Coleman and he attempted Coleman's lush, deep tone and, of course, they put themselves in with what they heard. And Ben was
very good, very good. He was one of the giants, we called them. But there was several of them around, in those days. And, --
